> Counts here come from a first pass in Python. The repo script (`npm run ch99:archive`) also finds 9903.88.21 in 2025HTSBasic–2026HTSRev7, whose footnote marker prints as a bare "/" in those PDFs; it is otherwise identical in all 54 revisions.

Method: heading rows = 9903.xx.xx codes on table pages (pages containing "Heading/" + "Article Description") that are immediately preceded by leader dots ("..") or a footnote marker ("1/"). A looser rule (also code at line start) gives identical sets for all 54 revisions. 2026HTSRev20 count = 637, equal to the ch99-coverage SUMMARY (637 9903 headings in HTS). Changed = row-text segment (text between previous row code and this code, headers/footers stripped) differs: APPROXIMATE, the segment includes the previous row's rate column tail, so a rate change on row N may be attributed to row N+1.
